notablePrerequisites: You have had three nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least three +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Tromell.
Repeat.
